eyebrow: REST APIs & Integration Fundamentals · Chapter 4, Lesson 16
subtitle: Which direction is the data actually moving?

steps.label: Inbound
steps.sub: an external system creates or updates Fusion records

steps.label: Outbound
steps.sub: Fusion data is read or extracted by an external system

steps.label: Both can be batch, REST, or event-driven
steps.sub: direction and pattern are separate decisions

code:
Inbound:  external system -> POST /invoices
            (vendor portal creates an AP invoice)

Outbound: external system -> GET /journals
            (data warehouse pulls GL entries nightly)
caption: POST/PATCH usually signal inbound; GET against Fusion usually signals outbound.

steps.label: Inbound example
steps.sub: a bank statement feed creates cash transactions in Fusion

steps.label: Outbound example
steps.sub: a BI tool extracts AP aging and GL balances for reporting

steps.label: Both at once
steps.sub: many real implementations run both directions for the same module
